I can’t run background monitoring or “ping” you later unless you set up an actual automation/integration (I don’t have a way to keep watching and notify you after this turn). I can, however, help immediately in three useful ways — pick one or more:

1) I’ll prepare a ready-to-use alert/automation recipe (Zapier/IFTTT/RSS → Slack or email) you can enable so you get notified the instant the PDF posts.  
2) I’ll draft a short “risk factors rundown” template I’ll use to summarize the PDF the moment you upload it (or paste the link). That makes the notification content ready.  
3) I can show you quick manual-monitoring steps (EDGAR/website/RSS/Google Alerts) so you can watch tonight and paste the PDF here when it arrives — then I’ll produce the rundown immediately.

Before I proceed, a couple quick clarifying questions so I tailor the solution:
- Which company / ticker / CIK and what filing (10-Q, 10-K, 8-K, “quarterly filings” = 10-Q?)  
- Where will the PDF be posted (SEC EDGAR, the company investor site, another portal)?  
- How do you want to be notified (Slack, email, SMS, other)?  
- What format/length for the risk factors rundown? (e.g., 5–8 bullet highlights + short action items; full page with citations; include verbatim quotes and page numbers?)

If you want to move fast, here are two things I can drop in right away:

A) Automation recipe (Zapier / RSS → Slack or email) — high level steps
- Identify the source RSS or URL where the filing will appear (SEC EDGAR company filings RSS or the company’s press/releases/feed).  
- Create a Zap: Trigger = New item in RSS feed (or New file in a specified folder/URL).  
- Add a Filter: Only continue when item title or content contains the filing type or quarter (e.g., “10-Q”, company name, “quarterly”).  
- Action = Send Slack message (to channel or DM) or Send Email with the link and a short template message. Optionally include a step to download the PDF to cloud storage.  
I can write the exact Zap fields/filters if you tell me the source and notification channel.

B) Risk-factors rundown template (example — I’ll use this to summarize once you provide the PDF/link)
- Headline: Filing type, company, date, pages analyzed.  
- Top 5 risk-factor highlights (1–2 lines each) — each with: short label, why it matters, page # / quote excerpt.  
- Material changes vs. prior filing (if known).  
- Potential impact (revenue, operations, regulation, liquidity).  
- Immediate recommended actions / watch items.  
- Full list of risk-factor headings and page references.

Tell me which option you want (automation recipe, summary template, manual-monitoring steps, or I can do all three), plus the clarifying details above, and I’ll prepare the next message you can act on right away. If you prefer, paste the link or upload the PDF when it appears and I’ll summarize the risk factors immediately.
